name: Pornstar Martini
description: Vanilla vodka, passion fruit and lime shaken and served up, with a chilled shot of sparkling wine on the side.
history: Douglas Ankrah created it at the Townhouse bar in London in the early 2000s, first calling it the Maverick Martini. It became the UK’s most-ordered cocktail for years.
whyItWorks: Passion fruit is sharp and perfumed; vanilla rounds it off and vodka stays out of the way. The sparkling wine is a palate cleanser between sips, not a topper.
garnish: Shot of sparkling wine on the side
steps: Shake vodka, passion fruit, lime and syrup hard with ice.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe and float half a passion fruit.
Serve a shot glass of cold prosecco alongside.
techniqueNotes: Ankrah’s spec adds 0.5 oz Passoã passion fruit liqueur. Without it, use a little more purée.
No vanilla vodka on the shelf: a drop of vanilla extract in the simple syrup does the job.
creator: Douglas Ankrah
